research_gaps: Lack of lightweight, real‑time monocular depth models that retain transformer‑level accuracy for edge devices.
Insufficient evaluation on diverse, large‑scale, in‑the‑wild datasets (e.g., TartanAir, Waymo Open) and under realistic runtime constraints.
Limited integration of test‑time adaptation with self‑supervised pre‑training for continual domain shift handling on deployment hardware.

proposals.name: Hybrid Conv‑Transformer Lite (HCT‑Lite)
proposals.rationale: Combine a shallow CNN stem for low‑level feature extraction with a token‑lite transformer encoder (e.g., MobileViT or Swin‑Tiny) to preserve global context while dramatically reducing FLOPs.
proposals.expected_benefit: Achieve <30 ms inference on a mid‑range mobile GPU (e.g., Snapdragon 8‑Gen 2) with <5% drop in depth‑error relative to full‑size DPT, enabling on‑device AR/robotics.
proposals.risk: Token‑lite designs may struggle with long‑range scene geometry, requiring careful positional encoding and multi‑scale fusion.

proposals.name: Self‑Supervised Multi‑Task Pre‑Training on Large‑Scale Video (SS‑MTP‑LTV)
proposals.rationale: Train a unified encoder on uncurated video streams (e.g., Waymo Open Motion, TartanAir) using self‑supervised photometric loss plus auxiliary heads for semantics and surface normals, then fine‑tune lightweight decoder for depth.
proposals.expected_benefit: Improves generalisation across domains and reduces the need for task‑specific data collection; multi‑task signals act as regularisers, boosting accuracy of the lightweight decoder.
proposals.risk: Training on massive video data demands substantial compute and careful curriculum design to avoid degenerate photometric minima.

proposals.name: Test‑Time Adaptive Token Pruning (TT‑ATP)
proposals.rationale: During inference, estimate domain shift via a lightweight statistic (e.g., feature covariance) and dynamically prune transformer tokens or adapt layer‑norm parameters, leveraging the self‑supervised pre‑trained backbone.
proposals.expected_benefit: Maintains high accuracy under unseen lighting or weather conditions while keeping average latency within real‑time bounds, providing a practical deployment‑time domain‑generalisation hook.
proposals.risk: Dynamic token pruning introduces variability in latency and may require hardware‑friendly implementation; effectiveness depends on reliable shift detection.

recommended_option: Hybrid Conv-Transformer Lite (HCT-Lite) combined with the Self-Supervised Multi-Task Pre-Training on Large-Scale Video (SS-MTP-LTV) – this dual approach first builds a compute‑efficient backbone and then endows it with robust, multi-domain representations, directly addressing the foremost gap of edge‑friendly high‑accuracy depth estimation.
